formAssemblyRules.description: Merge base retrofit questions, selected opportunity required inputs, tax/profile fields, bill/quote-prefill fields, and application-prep fields.
formAssemblyRules.conflictResolution: Keep one visible question per canonicalInputKey; union requiredFor, opportunity IDs, aliases, display conditions, and provenance; use stricter validation.

formAssemblyRules.description: Conservative defaults such as unit_count = 1 are visible, editable placeholders only.
formAssemblyRules.conflictResolution: Confirmed user, bill, quote, source, or admin values supersede placeholders while preserving provenance.

formAssemblyRules.description: Derived/defaulted answers must show provenance, confidence, source, and override affordance.
formAssemblyRules.conflictResolution: Prefer admin_reviewed for applications, quote_derived for cost/equipment, bill_derived for usage/savings, and user_entered over inferred or synthetic values.
formAssemblyRules.implementationNotes: Answer provenance belongs on answer records, not only catalog rows.

formAssemblyRules.description: Package required_inputs add to the form without forking reusable base questions.
formAssemblyRules.conflictResolution: Reuse existing canonicalInputKey when meaning matches; create a new question only for distinct semantics.
formAssemblyRules.implementationNotes: Keep source wording in package metadata.

formAssemblyRules.description: Tax, entity, jurisdiction, and organization fields stay reusable profile/tax questions.
formAssemblyRules.conflictResolution: Profile values prefill scenario answers with provenance; scenario overrides do not overwrite profile unless requested.
formAssemblyRules.implementationNotes: Tax fields have no production defaults; synthetic values are test-only.

formAssemblyRules.description: Bills and quotes may prefill values but must not hide uncertainty.
formAssemblyRules.conflictResolution: For cost/equipment prefer quote-derived; for usage/savings prefer bill/model-derived; surface conflicts for review.

formAssemblyRules.description: Application-prep statuses appear when estimating claimability or preparing submission.
formAssemblyRules.conflictResolution: Show one question with multiple requiredFor tags instead of duplicating it.
formAssemblyRules.implementationNotes: Use display conditions to avoid early-form overload.

formAssemblyRules.description: Scenario confidence drops for missing, placeholder, low-confidence, or sensitive unconfirmed inputs.
formAssemblyRules.conflictResolution: Use the worst unresolved confidenceImpactUntilConfirmed among required fields for the selected estimate type.
